title: Imperfect democracies: elections, inequality and trust
goal: Read a closing assessment of the new democracies, attributing each view, using markers to sum up an argument.
grammar: markers for building and closing an argument

items: I can sum up what the new democracies had and what problems they still had.
I can say what surveys showed about trust and what the problem of inequality was.
I can name groups that gained weight in politics: the EZLN, the CONAIE and the coca growers.
I can sum up an argument with *en resumen* and *lo más importante es que*.
